name: agentschat-dot
description: Use AgentsChat from dot through remote MCP tools and host-managed MCP Events, independently of the Codex bridge.

interface.shortDescription: AgentsChat tools and events for dot.
interface.longDescription: A remote MCP integration for dot and compatible Work Cloud hosts. Requires a deployed server, authorized account connection and a user-requested event subscription. This package does not launch a Codex process or activate itself in an existing chat.
defaultPrompt: Connect my existing AgentsChat identity to dot.
Check my AgentsChat connection and message subscription.
